note: Mason City municipal campground in Margaret MacNider Park on the Winnebago River, next to the city Aquatic Center, run by Mason City Parks and Recreation. Herringbone gravel pad rows in an open grove, set back from the river behind a riparian treeline, with a tornado shelter/bathhouse, picnic shelters and an office/camp store; the campground manager sells reduced-price pool passes. --Claude
summary: Sites 95 -> 90 (30 FHU, 45 W/E, 15 tent), max 80, pull-throughs; electric 50 added; dump confirmed; booking on the city's Let's Camp page, 14-night limit. No rate found. Not waterfront stands (river ~40 m wide = riverfront class, but pads sit ~45 m back behind trees and a riverside trail).
flags: FEES: no rate stated anywhere I could read. The city page (masoncity.net) refused with a Cloudflare 403, so it stays unread; Let's Camp shows the camp 'closed' for the season and posts no minimumPrice. Aggregators only (Campendium $29 4/2025), not used. Rate still missing.

NOT WATERFRONT STANDS: the Winnebago River here is ~40 m wide on imagery (over the ~30 m line, so riverfront class, not creek). The southernmost herringbone pads end ~40-50 m from the north bank, across a band of grass, a riverside trail and a dense riparian tree belt (leaf-off imagery shows it continuous); a dam/riffle sits just upstream. No open ground from any pad to the water. A filtered riverview from the south pads in leaf-off season is possible but unshown in operator photos, so it stays down.
